reviews.text: if yall love your animals, DO NOT TAKE THEM HERE EVER! My dog was having some liver issues and we took him here, as the Vet is allegedly a super accredited provider and has finished a top vet university. We couldn't have been more wrong. Not only did they MISDIAGNOSE my husky, they also OVERDOSED him, TWICE, when they were going to in to see whats wrong. They gave my dog a diagnosis that he has cancer and would be dying in 3 months and unless we wanted to pay $13,000 for a surgery, we should put him down. We took him to a different doctor on SI and not only was the diagnosis VERY wrong, we were then told that my dog was overdosed, TWICE. We went from a 3 month timeframe of life to getting another 2 1/2 years because we DIDN'T listen to this POS place. PLEASE for the love of your animal, bringing them to this POS place would quite literally kill them. Theres a couple reccomendations i have in Brooklyn that will not only do everything necessary to save your animal, THEY WILL NOT SUGGEST TO PUT YOUR ANIMAL DOWN AS THE FIRST COURSE OF TREATMENT. (greenwood veterinary care/bensonhurst veterinary care is my top choice. It's the same practice but in two locations, which is why they have different names).

Shameful manipulation - I have had 4 dogs in my adults life. I have spent my fair share of time at emergency vets. Never in my life have I experiences such blatant manipulation in hopes of making the bill higher and higher.
The prices were astounding. Rehydrating him with an IV was going to cost $700 where it costs $60 just down the street at another emergency vet. The Dr used every car-salesmen tactic to try to get me to agree to all manner of tests rather than attend to what his current needs were as I assured her that we would bring him to his usual vet for follow up.
On top of this a vet tech either lied or was very badly trained as she assured us repeatedly our dog would be seen within an hour when in fact it was going to be 5 hours. She also said he would have blood work done right away when that would never have happened without the Dr. first speaking with us. No one would acknowledge that the tech misled us which led us to believe lying to us in order to keep us there, as we at first told the desk we might try going to another emergency vet with a shorter wait, was the goal all along.
If I was not an experienced dog owner and veteran of emergency vets I would have fallen for their tactics and left with thousands of dollars of unneeded tests. STAY AWAY - blue pearl, kind vet, park slope veterinary are all much better options!

DO NOT GO HERE. They OVER MEDICATED my dog and she had a seizure because of them. She has never had a seizure or suffers from them. THEY GIVE high-dose adult medications that immobilized my dog. This is PLEASE go with caution if necessary and use your common sense before you over medicate your dog because of their lack of experience or care. I went after 12am if you can wait until going to your regular vet the next day I would HIGHLY suggest that. This happened to my friend and from what I read to a lot others so I am not the only one.
Staff was professional and fast, our doctor was great and explained everything thoroughly. They even handled the bill for some reason!

Dr. DiFazio, Dr. Freliech, Dr. Gordon, Dr. Morgan, and staff saved my dog’s life. He was in the ICU for almost two weeks with a complicated issue and the vets and staff were compassionate, tenacious, and communicative the entire time. This was a year ago, but I literally think about this team every single day and feel so lucky that they treated my boy ♥️

My dog is currently having a procedure at VERG. I hope I find the right words to express my gratitude to Dr. Anjana Mangalat. As a registered nurse, I understand the importance of showing empathy to patients so her kindness and her sincere concern made all the difference. Dr. Mangalat spent so much time with me explaining what was wrong with Milo, what was the best options for Milo and gave recommendations for his future care. I truly feel blessed to have met her and the team at VERG that are caring for him right now.

With sincere gratitude, I thank you.

Katherine Bruno

The staff was really nice including the triage nurse and the ladies at the desk, but my cat has not been seen by a doctor even after 5,5 hours wait. Even though the issue does not seem to be life threatening and still persists and we have to look for the vet now after completely sleepless night. Clear estimation and communication about the vet  and how crucial it is to stay would help a lot not ruin my week.

The staff are kind and appear competent? The main problem is the complete lack of communication and patient protocol.

You bring your pet in because you believe, or you’re told, it’s an emergency. They very quickly assess if the pet is in immediate danger or “stable.” If stable, they just hand the pet back to you with no information, no indication if there’s real urgency. When I asked so what happens now? They say “you’ll be seen by a doctor.” However, there is no time frame at all. Emergencies are always taken first. I waited 3 hours in a freezing dismal waiting room with absolutely no sense as to whether it was necessary or what they or I should do. After 3 hours I just left with my cat who had been vomiting repeatedly with diarrhea.

Organizationally this place is a DISASTER. Go ONLY if your pet is collapsing, not breathing or imminently dying.

Our precious dog Lulu spent her last days at this amazing hospital. She was only 4 and came down with ITP suddenly. The care we received was beyond exceptional! From the time we walked in the door until we left a few days later I knew that they did everything humanly possible to keep our precious pet alive. I must highlight the ICU staff. Everyone was so compassionate and professional! There was a doctor I will never ever forget. His name is Dr. Curtis Rheingold. We have never seen a doctor as wonderful as this man. We can’t say enough good things about him. He stayed with us every step of the way , for days, and took the best care of not only our beautiful pet but had  such empathy for our entire family. He took a tragic experience in our lives and turned it into a poignant memory. We will never forget Dr. Curtis Rheingold and the staff at VERG!  Thank you to all of them! With much gratitude, The Siedman Family.

I would like to Thank Dr Cohen with all my heart and all her staff too many to name for taking such great care of our cat Jack and giving my daughter 7 months more with him. Unfortunately this Sunday Jack passed away peacefully surrounded by family in my daughter's arms after putting up a good fight against large cell b lymphoma.  This was because he had such a great hard working dedicated team that got him over so many obstacles these 7 months.  I often read post and reviews of pet owners blaming a doctor, hospital or staff. I wanted to say to anyone who reads this remember we are all human beings and try our best. To remember that even though you have a emergency remember everyone is there for the same reason. Some emergencies prioritize before others. Which brings me to all the girls at the front desk just to name a few Amy,Banks,Dawn,Janice,mckayla,Rose and Kia. They are there to help you. You couldn't ask for a better staff. I want to thank Kia for being there the night we brought Jacks final and last stop goodbye to Verg.  You made one of the hardest nights comforting and helping us with the arrangements. Again our love to Dr Cohen who called us as soon as she heard that night. VERG is family to us and Jack. Cancer killed my cat not those who tried their best to help him. I am forever grateful to all of you and wish you all the best. Made friends along this journey and hope to keep in touch. To anyone going there or think of going there you couldn't be in better hands.

Extremely disappointed with my first experience at VERG Brooklyn. I brought my cat in for ongoing constipation issues and, after a very long wait, the vet spent no more than five minutes with him listened to his heart, checked his ears, felt his stomach a few times, and left.

I was given an estimate for additional services that I found extremely expensive, so I decided to seek care elsewhere. I was then charged a $200 examination fee.

I completely understand paying for a vet’s time and expertise, but $200 for such a brief, basic examination felt ridiculous and completely disproportionate to the care provided. The entire experience felt like a money grab, and I would not return.

I brought my dog there for his hind limb dragging they prescribed some pain killers basically and told me consult with his primary vet or a specialist.. go to Blue Pearl or your primary vet and save yourself the experience and some money.
Wonderful, kind and caring staff!! Thank you for helping my precious old guy Tony feel so much better in the middle of the night. We appreciate you!!

Hi Joe,

Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review. We value all feedback and are always looking for ways to improve. If you’re willing, we would appreciate the opportunity to learn more about your experience, as a rating alone doesn’t provide us with enough information to understand what happened or how we can do better. Please feel free to reach out to our management team to share your concerns. We would be grateful for the opportunity to listen and learn from your experience.

I brought my cat to VERG Animal Center on August 13th to see an internal medicine specialist because of persistent diarrhea. He had already been treated for Tritrichomonas by his regular veterinarian, and the specialist recommended repeating the test to confirm that the infection had actually been cleared. I was told that once the results were available, we would discuss the next steps and develop a treatment plan.

I brought in the requested stool sample the very next day, August 14th.

Today is August 25th, and I still have no results, no treatment plan, and no communication from the internal medicine department whatsoever.

I have called and left four messages, sent an email, and specifically requested that an office manager call me back. Despite all of these attempts, nobody has returned my call or contacted me to discuss my cat’s care.

I paid approximately $350 for the internal medicine consultation, and at this point the entire visit feels pointless because there has been absolutely no follow-up or continuity of care.

I understand that veterinary hospitals can be busy, but 11 days with no response after submitting a requested diagnostic sample—and after repeatedly contacting the hospital—is unacceptable, especially when this involves an ongoing medical problem and a treatment plan that was supposed to be discussed based on the test results.

The biggest issue here is not even the delay itself; it is the complete lack of communication and accountability. I should not have to repeatedly chase a specialty veterinary hospital just to get an update on my pet’s test results and treatment.

I expected much better from a specialty hospital and would not recommend VERG based on this experience.

as a 1st time cat owner I never imagined a visit to the vet, or emergency no less.
my biggie was very sick with a blockage, and I didn't know the severity of what  a blockage would do to a male cat. my poor biggie was in pain.. from the  moment he was brought in my family said they felt welcomed,  and were met by an incredible caring medical staff. our cat was in their care from Monday to Thursday with at least 2 updates each day from many of the staff, and doctor's. I would like to express my most sincerest gratitude to the entire staff for all of your help and care. thank you

Hi Jereny!

Thank you so much for your 5 star review! We truly appreciate your support and are grateful for the opportunity to care for your pet. Your trust means so much to our entire team. 🐾💚

You could not save my kitten and I will never forgive you for that and I will never go to this hospital ever again. Now I can not even get an animal myself because I could not save him amd you spelled his name wrong. That was a $3000 dollar Maincoon. I hope you guys go out of buisness. I do not support you. I cried everyday for a month or longer. I hate you guys. I don't love you. Please do not forget your position again.

Really appreciated the front desk team at VERG Brooklyn they are wonderful kind hearted people who really care. We walked in at midnight this morning with our cat named Puma who had issues with his stomach as a second opinion. The front desk staff member named Tamika was very professional, she did a wonderful job doing the check-in procedure and make sure that we had time look over the paperwork and ensured everything went smoothly before Puma was called to be checked by the nurse. The other staff member named Jelenny who was working on the medical billing at the front desk was excellent and make sure we had a chance to review everything. She made sure that all the pricing was outlined, ask if we have pet insurance, and make sure the experience was seamless. We would also say that Dr. Martinez is a wonderful vet doctor who has great professionalism, very patient, and compassion for his patients. Dr. Martinez took the time to explain everything from start of the examination, to when Puma was ready to be discharged. Dr. Martinez gave us a chance to ask questions and understand pet owners. Dr. Martinez took the chance to explain the treatment plan and understood our financial limitations. We went yesterday to another vet hospital and we left without answers to our questions. We had documentation from the other vet hospital and Dr. Martinez reviewed everything and provided feedback on the treatment plan that recommended. Dr. Martinez did a full analysis on Puma and did X-rays as well. We came back recently and Dr. Nadler was amazing. Dr. Nadler was super communicative and explained everything when Puma was admitted. I received a call this afternoon with good news regarding Puma. I really appreciate the team at VERG Brooklyn. The process was a few hours which went by very quickly and swiftly. We appreciate everyone at VERG Brooklyn you guys are amazing and the best Vet Hospital in Brooklyn.

Waited in the waiting room for 3 1/2 hours from 10pm to 1:30 am and couldn’t even get an estimated weight time. Ended up leaving and going to the Blue Pearl ER. Waiting room was empty so if you plan to go here you better free up your entire day to just sit around and waste your time. Do yourself a favor and don’t come here
